stops.note: Leopold von Sacher-Masoch, born in Lemberg (Lviv) in 1836, wrote the novel Venus in Furs (1870)
Richard von Krafft-Ebing coined it in 1890, while Sacher-Masoch was still alive and much to his displeasure
entered English through the 1893 translation of Krafft-Ebing's Psychopathia Sexualis

current_meaning: pleasure, especially sexual, from one's own pain or humiliation
